purpose: Upload 上传; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandUpload](../../lib/src/components/upload.dart), [IslandUploadFile](../../lib/src/components/upload_types.dart), [IslandUploadSource](../../lib/src/components/upload_types.dart), [IslandUploadChange](../../lib/src/components/upload_types.dart), [IslandUploadCancellation](../../lib/src/components/upload_types.dart), [IslandUploadTransfer](../../lib/src/components/upload_types.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten. Platform integration signatures are defined separately in lib/animal_island_upload_platform.dart; the core accepts typed IO callbacks.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Host list is authoritative. Insertion precedes transport; each progress transaction waits for parent acknowledgement. Accepted removal, source replacement or disposal cancels only owned jobs. Preflight is serialized and generation-bound, including error delivery afterdisable/disposal. Removal result/error delivery additionally requires the same current file source. Disabling invalidates pending selection/removal intents; already accepted transport jobs retain their existing lifetime.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win. Modal Tab traversal consumes forward and reverse keys even when a closed loop keeps the same target or contains no actions. One shared boundary in the existing action module delegates order to the existing FocusScope, owns one skipped non-semantic target for an otherwise empty scope, and removes its borrowed-scope listener and owned node on disposal. It does not inspect children, add another FocusScope or replace a caller-owned focus target. IslandDialogRoute now defaults explicitly to TraversalEdgeBehavior.closedLoop; an explicitly supplied non-closed-loop policy, including null inheritance from Navigator, remains authoritative. Drawer, Loading, showIslandModal and the shared preview/alert route consume this same behavior. Actual Web keyboard and Windows/AT validation remain separate from widget tests. Slot layout: in picture-card mode child is centred in the 84x84 add tile and constrained to it; in drag mode it is centred in a zone that fills the parent width with 30px vertical and 22px horizontal inset (reference 28px/20px padding plus the 2px dashed border); otherwise child replaces the default button and is laid out by the parent unchanged.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. Card status content owns an opaque pale backing above arbitrary thumbnail slots (uploading: spinner over percentage, 4px gap; failed: 22px #e05a5a close mark); card preview/delete actions are 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45) discs (.65 on preview hover) whose white icons keep 3:1 over any thumbnail pixel; row preview/delete actions are transparent 22px discs that take rgba(0,0,0,.08) and a same-hue 3:1 teal/red icon on hover; a finished card border is #c4b89e. Transparent tip defaults inherit the host theme. Hidden hover controls reject pointer hits while keyboard focus reveals the same subtree. Preview route uses shared opaque displacement and a visible close focus ring; component retains cancellation and route ownership. Generic previews and Gallery alert callbacks reuse public IslandDialogRoute, the sole owner of opaque displacement and reduced-motion settlement. The creator pushes on the root Navigator and retains exact-route lifetime; builder retains content, semantics and surface. Existing showIslandModal scale entry remains its separate reference contract. Dashed strokes use the single public foundation painter under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke. This component retains its existing shape, color, width, dash/gap, state and content ownership; no second contour loop or consumer-private import. Drag-zone and picture-card add-tile content (default or caller child) inherits the zone tint as DefaultTextStyle and IconTheme defaults: muted at rest, link on hover or drag; explicit child styles win. Tint and dashed colour ease over the reference 0.2s; the drag zone takes the teal background only while dragging, the add tile also on hover and is transparent at rest; the focus ring switches atomically. Text and picture rows lay out icon or thumbnail (picture: 30px #fffdf7 box, 18px file icon), a flexible name column, the file size only when the file has one (IslandUploadFile.size null shows none), and status with 8px gaps; preview/delete actions follow at 12px. Without progress an uploading file keeps the spinner and percentage. Progress appears only while a file uploads; done and failed files keep their status icons; displayed percentages clamp to 0-100 and read NaN as 0. Bar progress is a small Progress below the name (6px gap, 11px value, showInfo from the config) or, in a picture card over the dark overlay, under its percentage (6px gap, info hidden); the card percentage is the reference white text on the card overlay, whose alpha is .565 so the text keeps 4.5:1 over any thumbnail pixel. A background fill shown without its percentage and without a caller colour draws a 2px #008e81 end edge. Background progress is a separate semantics node behind the content, clipped to the item radius: its fill (caller color or #19c8b9) is painted at .28 opacity with the optional white wave and eases over the configured duration (cubic .4,0,.2,1, none under reduced motion); the 11px bold #794f27 percentage replaces the spinner and is excluded from semantics; a picture card replaces the dark overlay with rgba(255,253,247,.88). Waves play only strictly between 0% and 100%.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: An uploading file in a text, picture or picture-card list, with no progress, bar progress or background progress
scenarios.when: Its percent changes, it finishes or fails, or the percent is NaN
scenarios.then: No progress keeps the spinner; bar shows a named Progress with the file percentage; background fills the item from the left behind its content with its own named value, leaving preview/delete actions separately reachable; finished files show status icons only; NaN reads 0%.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.when: Parent rejects, removes/replaces an ID, disables, or unmounts
scenarios.then: No unaccepted transfer begins or stale file is revived. Cancelled selection/preflight/removal intents do not deliver stale error callbacks; a pending removal is also bound to current file source identity. Current errors report once. Accepted removal/source replacement/disposal cancels owned transfers; disabling alone retains already accepted transfers.

scenarios.given: Picker and drag batches with accept/multiple/maxCount and asynchronous beforeUpload
scenarios.when: Batches overlap or maxCount=1 replaces a file
scenarios.then: Both input paths enforce the same rules, keep deterministic order and emit exact excess files; replacement cancels only the replaced job.

scenarios.given: A request emits many progress events in one frame
scenarios.when: The host acknowledges changes and the request completes
scenarios.then: Progress is coalesced to the newest value; terminal success follows without draining obsolete per-event frame work.

scenarios.given: A positive logical border and the local MediaQuery DPR
scenarios.when: The component or its Gallery reference frame resolves a border
scenarios.then: IslandTheme.borderWidth is the unique owner: whole physical pixels rounded down, minimum one physical pixel. DPR1 appearance is retained; text line boxes and counts are not border metrics.

scenarios.given: The relevant owned state and actual supported background, including transition frames
scenarios.when: Focus, hover, entry, exit or reduced motion changes
scenarios.then: Card status content owns an opaque pale backing above arbitrary thumbnail slots (uploading: spinner over percentage, 4px gap; failed: 22px #e05a5a close mark); card preview/delete actions are 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45) discs (.65 on preview hover) whose white icons keep 3:1 over any thumbnail pixel; row preview/delete actions are transparent 22px discs that take rgba(0,0,0,.08) and a same-hue 3:1 teal/red icon on hover; a finished card border is #c4b89e. Transparent tip defaults inherit the host theme. Hidden hover controls reject pointer hits while keyboard focus reveals the same subtree. Preview route uses shared opaque displacement and a visible close focus ring; component retains cancellation and route ownership.

scenarios.given: The component-owned modal boundary, or its registered Gallery alert callback, with zero/one/multiple actions
scenarios.when: Forward/reverse Tab, activation, dismissal, rejected close or owner removal occurs
scenarios.then: Closed loops consume Tab without leaving the modal; callbacks fire once and accepted close restores origin. Explicit route traversal overrides survive, opaque child identity/styles remain, and owned focus resources are cleaned up.

scenarios.given: The existing dashed recipe in each supported size, applicable state and target pixel ratio, with opaque content
scenarios.when: Render and update the same component, including its current hover/press/focus and stroke-width recipes where applicable
scenarios.then: The contour, final short dash and inset match the unchanged recipe; all drawing uses the shared public foundation mechanism. Content geometry, callback/focus behavior and lifecycle remain unchanged under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke.
